name: Zollverein Coal Mine Industrial Complex in Essen
description: Zollverein is a vast former coal mine and coking plant in Essen, in western Germany. Mining began here in the 1850s and ended in 1986, and the coking plant ran until 1993. Today you can walk among its huge brick-and-steel buildings, including Shaft 12, a clean-lined 1932 Bauhaus-influenced design often called the "most beautiful coal mine in the world.
